entities.name: Yuri Gagarin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Soviet cosmonaut (1934–1968) who on April 12, 1961 became the first human being to journey into outer space, orbiting Earth once aboard Vostok 1 in a 108-minute flight. His achievement marked the pinnacle of the Soviet space program and opened the era of human space exploration.
